+import numpy as np
+import casa_tool
+
+s = casa_tool.Session('/app/instance.npz')
+m, d = s.model, s.data
+site_id = m.site('gripper0_right_grip_site').id
+obj_id = m.body('obj_main').id
+base_id = m.body('robot0_base').id
+
+def pose():
+    return d.site_xpos[site_id].copy(), d.xpos[obj_id].copy()
+
+def report(tag):
+    p, o = pose()
+    print(tag, len(s.actions), 'grip', np.round(p, 3), 'obj', np.round(o, 3),
+          'dist', round(np.linalg.norm(p-o),3), 'success',s.check()['success'], flush=True)
+
+def action(grip=-1, arm=None, torso=0, base=None, mode=-1):
+    a = np.zeros(12)
+    a[6] = grip
+    a[11] = mode
+    if arm is not None: a[:6] = arm
+    if base is not None: a[7:10] = base
+    a[10] = torso
+    s.step(a)
+
+def move(tag, target, grip=-1, tol=.015, max_steps=80, gain=.7):
+    target = np.array(target, float)
+    for i in range(max_steps):
+        p, _ = pose()
+        error = target-p
+        if np.linalg.norm(error) < tol: break
+        rot = d.xmat[base_id].reshape(3,3)
+        local = rot.T @ error
+        arm = np.zeros(6)
+        arm[:3] = np.clip(gain*local/.05, -1, 1)
+        action(grip, arm=arm)
+        if i%10==9: report(tag)
+    report(tag+' done')
+
+def hold(n, grip=-1, tag='hold'):
+    for i in range(n):
+        action(grip)
+    report(tag)
+
+report('start')
+move('raise', [0.55,-.952,1.49], max_steps=50)
+move('approach', [0.275,-.956,1.47], max_steps=100)
+hold(12, -1, 'pre-grasp')
+hold(18, 1, 'grasp')
+move('pull', [0.58,-.956,1.50], grip=1, max_steps=100)
+hold(10,1,'post-pull')
*** End Patch"));
